attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to compromise an Azure account by exploiting weak or guessed passwords for initial access.
description: A risky sign-in attempt was observed in Azure.
investigative_actions: Monitor the user account for indications of compromise, such as irregular login patterns or atypical activities. Reach out to the user to confirm the legitimacy of the recent password reset activity. Continue monitoring the account for any subsequent actions that may indicate suspicious behavior.
